attribution.rationale: Confirm that the CUDA rollout execution optimization leaves adjacent transformer, GRPO update, auxiliary-loss, and reward contracts unchanged.

decisions.rationale: The change only optimizes autoregressive generation buffers, sampling placement, and finished-row compaction. Transformer construction, configuration, parameter initialization, and forward semantics are unchanged.

Causal prefix scoring and cache semantics are unchanged. The generation path only selects live batch rows from the existing cache and preserves their order; model logits and prefix-score calculations are untouched.
GRPO batch construction and optimizer update semantics are unchanged. Rollout completion order and grouping are preserved, while token sampling and storage remain an execution optimization.
The valid-next-token auxiliary loss, its targets, masking, weighting, and optimization path are unchanged; the changed rollout collector still returns the same ordered token lists.
Verifier reward and coverage shaping are unchanged. The optimization changes how generated tokens are sampled and buffered, not how completed paths are parsed or rewarded.
The sterile-repetition penalty and reward composition are unchanged. Generated completion representation and ordering at the reward boundary remain the same.
